verdict.rationale: Runway Dev ships a documented public HTTP API. The evidence covers concrete endpoints such as POST /v1/text_to_video and GET /v1/tasks/{id} polling, an official SDK, cURL examples, a Playground, and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Probes confirmed that /openapi.json and llms.txt are live, which makes the API agent-friendly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of using the API in practice.
